description: Implementation of the AudioRendererSink class for audio rendering, including methods for starting, stopping, setting volume and playback rate, and handling source status updates and errors.

classes.name: AudioRendererSinkImpl
classes.description: Class implementing audio sink functionality, managing audio playback, volume, rate, and source status callbacks.

methods.name: AudioRendererSinkImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the sink with default or custom creation function.

methods.name: IsAudioSampleTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific audio sample type is supported.

methods.name: IsAudioFrameStorageTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific audio frame storage type is supported.

methods.name: GetNearestSupportedSampleFrequency
methods.description: Returns the nearest supported sample frequency for a given value.

methods.name: HasStarted
methods.description: Checks if the audio sink has been started.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts audio rendering with specified parameters and callback.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops audio rendering and destroys the sink.

methods.name: SetPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate, supporting only 0 (pause) or 1 (play).
